program.checker_template: Evaluate ONE independent required condition against the SOURCE and EDITED images. No reference label, previous answers or optimization feedback is supplied. Return pass if the condition is satisfied, fail if it is not satisfied, or unknown if the evidence cannot establish an answer. Inspect only this saved condition, its criteria and binding. d1: The binding is underspecified for the requested edit: it asks only whether a mug is right of the headphones, so it can pass when the original mug remains left and an extra mug has been added on the right. In the edited image, the original blue mug appears as a blurred remnant on the left, while two small mugs are visible; the rightmost mug satisfies the relation, but the image does not clearly establish that the original mug was moved or that the edit is complete. Bind the check to the mug in the source image and assess its post-edit position, while distinguishing that object from newly introduced duplicates. Preserve uncertainty if identity or completion cannot be determined. The five high-confidence yes traces consistently support the local relation, not full task completion; the partial reference concerns aggregate progress, so do not force a no or weaken the positional criterion. No transport, schema, or dependency failures are reported.
